description.value: Carnitas Don José is a food court stall in downtown Vancouver helmed by Don José Velázquez, an 8-time Mexican Charrería national champion turned chef who brings carnitas estilo Michoacán to the city. The menu centres on slow-cooked pork served in tacos, tortas, and combo plates made with locally sourced ingredients. It holds a 4.7-star Uber Eats rating from over 1,500 reviews and is accessible for delivery through both Uber Eats and DoorDash.
